brand.name: Persona
step1.title: What should we call you?
step1.hint: Your name appears in messages and approvals.
step1.label: Your name
step2.title: About the company
step2.hint: Tell us what the company does, its clients, tone of voice and rules. This becomes the Vault, which the team reads before every task.
step2.label: Company context
step2.placeholder: Describe in plain language or paste text…
byc.title: Bring what your AIs already know
byc.collapsibleTeaser: Already use ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini? Bring what they know about you
byc.providerHint.chatgpt: Open a new chat in ChatGPT, paste the request, and send. Then copy the full reply.
byc.providerHint.claude: In Claude, open a new chat (ideally in a Project you already use), paste, and send.
byc.providerHint.gemini: In Gemini, paste the request in a new chat and copy the reply.
byc.providerHint.other: Works with any AI that remembers you: paste, send, and copy the reply.
byc.copyBlockTitle: Copy this request and send it to the AI you already use
byc.copyBlockLead: The text is the same on every tab — only the where-to-paste hint changes.
byc.pastePlaceholder: One paste per AI — you can paste again later.
byc.folderDropHint: We only read .md files. We skip .obsidian, trash, and attachments, and list what was left out.
byc.privacy: Everything stays on this computer. Passwords, documents, and bank details are blocked before they enter the Vault.
byc.vaultHostPending: To organize a folder, open the Persona app on this computer.
byc.review.constraintNotice: {count} rules will be mandatory for the team once saved
byc.review.constraintNotice.one: 1 rule will be mandatory for the team once saved
byc.review.pendingRules: {count} rules are waiting for your choice
byc.review.pendingRules.one: 1 rule is waiting for your choice
byc.review.pendingRuleNote: Rules you do not choose are left out
step4.coordinatorReply: Got it. Draft ready: {name} · {role}. Tweak below and continue.
step3.title: AI tools on this computer
step3.hint: We found AI tools you are already signed in to. You can connect later, and we never ask for a password.
step4.title: Build your team
step4.hint: Start with the suggested template: you adjust everything before hiring.
step4.builderPlaceholder: E.g. I need someone to review contracts and reply to clients…
step4.structureOpen: Not sure where to start? Open the Structure assistant
step5.title: First delivery
step5.hint: A small, useful request — your team works for real and you see the result in #general.
step5.taskPreview: Summarize in 5 bullet points what the team already knows about the company (Vault) and propose the first practical task for the week.
step5.taskPreviewEmpty: List 3 things the team can do for you this week with what it already knows.
step5.workingBody: {name} is on the request. The delivery shows up here and in #general.
step5.workingNotice: This uses the AI engine you connected. It may take a minute.
step5.needsEngineTitle: The team needs an AI to work.
step5.needsEngineBody: Connect an AI tool and the first delivery comes right after.
step5.slowBody: Still working. You can go in; the delivery arrives in #general and I’ll let you know.
step5.activationPrompt: Team, please: summarize in 5 bullet points what you already know about our company from the Vault and propose one practical first task for this week.
step5.activationPromptEmpty: Team, please: list 3 concrete things you can do for me this week and execute the first one.
step3.connectRequired: Connect at least one AI engine so the team can deliver real work. Use the login you already have in the terminal.
guide.name: Guide
step1.guideSays: Hi! I'll help you set up your team in 5 quick steps.
step2.guideSays: Tell us about the company. What you write becomes the Vault — your team uses it before every task.
step3.guideSays: We found these tools on this computer. No passwords: we use the login you already have.
step4.guideSays: Pick a team template or describe who you need. You can edit everything later.
step5.guideSays: Let's request the first real delivery — under two minutes.
step4.builderToggle: Prefer to describe it in your own words?
step3.checkingNotice: I’m checking the AI tools on this computer. It takes a few seconds.
